Trail Technology · Unit 8: Magnetism & Wireless Technology · Module 7

Electromagnetic Induction

Magnetic flux, Faraday’s and Lenz’s laws, generators, eddy currents, transformers and AC.

Lesson coming

The question

How does a dynamo hub make light just from riding?

The physics

  • Magnetic flux
  • Faraday’s law
  • Lenz’s law
  • Generators
  • Eddy currents
  • Transformers
  • AC circuits
  • Inductors

The math

  • Φ = BA cos θ
  • emf = −N ΔΦ / Δt

Learning objectives

  • Calculate magnetic flux
  • Use Faraday’s law to find an induced emf
  • Use Lenz’s law to find the direction of an induced current
  • Explain how a generator or dynamo makes electricity
  • Describe transformers and AC

Helps to know first: Magnetism.

The mountain biking connection

A dynamo hub spins magnets past coils to light a bike. The same physics lets a motor work as a generator, and is behind magnetic braking.
